text: Workflows can run automatically on a recurring schedule via a Scheduled trigger
quote: Workflows can now run automatically on a recurring schedule. Add a Scheduled trigger, choose the interval and start time, and let the workflow run without a call event.

text: Conversations log appointments booked during calls and let you filter for booking attempts
quote: Conversations now show appointments saved during a call, including the time, status, hosts, and provider link.

text: Sign in with a six-digit email code that auto-submits
quote: Sign in with a six-digit code sent by email; telli submits it automatically when all digits are entered

text: Choose SMS/WhatsApp workflow recipients from contact properties, collected values, or a fixed number
quote: Choose SMS and WhatsApp workflow recipients from contact properties, collected values, or a fixed number

text: Agents can generate SMS message text from instructions instead of only sending fixed text
quote: Let agents generate SMS messages from instructions instead of sending only fixed text

text: Dashboard tracks reach rate, call duration, and success rate metrics
quote: Track key metrics like reach rate, call duration, and success rate.

text: Analyze individual calls, transcripts, and call outcome fields
quote: Analyze individual calls, transcripts, and call outcome fields.

text: Configure dialing windows, calling strategies, and retry behavior for outbound campaigns
quote: Configure dialing windows, calling strategies, and retry behavior.

text: Submit feedback on calls to continuously improve your agent
quote: Submit feedback on calls to continuously improve your agent.

text: Charlie, a built-in AI assistant, can build/refine agents, automate workflows, and analyze calls
quote: Charlie: Build and refine agents, automate workflows, and analyze your calls with telli's built-in AI assistant.

text: REST API to programmatically manage contacts, schedule calls, and integrate with existing systems
quote: API Endpoints: Use telli's REST API to programmatically manage contacts, schedule calls, and integrate with your existing systems.

text: Webhooks deliver real-time notifications about call events, status changes, and outcomes
quote: Webhooks: Receive real-time notifications about call events, status changes, and outcomes.

text: Custom tools let agents connect to your APIs to access external information
quote: Custom tools allow your AI agents to access external information by connecting to your APIs.

text: Download a machine-readable API spec to generate client libraries or give coding agents API context
quote: Download them to generate client libraries, import the API into tools like Postman, or give coding agents machine-readable API context

text: Schedule a call for the earliest opportunity within the configured dialer window
quote: Schedules a call at the earliest opportunity within the dialer window. May occur immediately or on the next business day depending on settings.

text: Optional flag to bypass dialing window restrictions and call at the exact scheduled time
quote: Optional flag to bypass dialing window restrictions for the scheduled call. When true, calls at the scheduled time regardless of dialing windows.

text: Bring your own SIP trunk to import existing phone numbers or connect your phone system for calls
quote: Imports a phone number from your own SIP trunk provider. This allows you to use existing phone numbers with telli by configuring custom SIP termination settings.

text: MCP server lets AI tools like Claude, ChatGPT, and Codex talk to the built-in AI assistant
quote: The telli MCP server lets AI tools like Claude, ChatGPT, and Codex talk to Charlie, telli's AI assistant, over the Model Context Protocol.

text: Automatic data retention deletes contacts and call data once they reach a defined age
quote: Data retention deletes contacts and call data automatically once they reach an age you define.

text: Audio recording can be made conditional on caller consent
quote: In telli, you can easily make audio recording conditional on the caller's consent — so a call is only recorded once they agree.

text: Voice cloning lets you give an agent a custom voice from a real person's voice sample
quote: Voice cloning lets you give your agent a custom voice (your own, a colleague's, or a professional voice actor's), so the agent sounds exactly the way you want on every call.

text: Test call feature lets you pick an agent version (draft or saved revision) to try before deploying
quote: In the agent builder, click Test call to open the dialog. Pick the agent version (your draft with unsaved changes or any saved revision)...

text: Side-by-side view lets you listen to a call recording while following the transcript
quote: Use the side-by-side view to listen to the recording while following along in the transcript.

text: Agents can enable a web_search tool to look up current public information during calls
quote: For a Duo agent, open Tools > System and enable web_search to let the agent search the web for current public information during calls.

text: Transfer tools move a live call to another agent or number
quote: Transfer tools | Move the call to another agent or number.

text: Live Monitoring gives a real-time overview of ongoing calls
quote: Live Monitoring > Real-time call overview of your contacts

text: API authentication uses an API key issued from Settings > Developer, sent as a bearer token
quote: All endpoints authenticate with an API key from the telli app (Settings > Developer), sent as a bearer token

text: Keep your public business number and forward incoming calls to a telli number via your provider/PBX
quote: Keep your public business number and forward incoming calls to a telli number. You configure the forwarding with your phone provider or PBX.
